# World Brief — Saturday, 10 October 2026

**In one line:** The RBI launched aggressive emergency currency curbs to defend the weak rupee, while US officials defended their green card pause and Hurricane Isaias killed four in the Southeast.

## ☕ Don't have time? Read this
- **RBI launched emergency foreign exchange curbs** to stop the rupee from falling further against the dollar.
- **US officials defended pausing green card filings** for major tech firms, but H-1B work permits remain valid.
- **Hurricane Isaias killed four people** in the US Southeast and cut power to hundreds of thousands.
- **The Indian Supreme Court set a rare Sunday hearing** over mass protest detentions in New Delhi.
- **The US disabled an oil cargo ship** running an Iran blockade as Middle East tensions flared.
- **SEBI announced traffic-light risk labels** for bonds and will issue rules for AI use in markets.
